summary: All 4 blocking findings are valid and should be repaired in spec.json.

items.title: Report context is required before it exists in the normal flow
items.rationale: The current normal flow does not produce report.json before final-regression, so acceptance-review cannot require report context unconditionally at its planned position.
items.evidence: spec-review.json finding 1; spec.json data_flow and scope currently list report context as a required acceptance-review input.

items.title: Amendment and decision routes have no concrete flow integration target
items.rationale: The spec must name the command/state/artifact/reset integration for amend_required, user_decision_required, blocked, abort, repair, and risk-acceptance routes so implementation and tests converge.
items.evidence: spec-review.json finding 2; current spec R10-R12 name outcomes but not concrete flow integration targets.

items.title: Next-action envelope field names conflict with the existing public contract
items.rationale: The existing public next-action envelope uses snake_case requires_approval and output_schema. The spec must preserve those fields and make failurePolicy additive only.
items.evidence: spec-review.json finding 3; src/flow/lib/get-next-action.js returns requires_approval and output_schema.

items.title: Acceptance-review completion is not tied to the existing step completion guard
items.target: R5 / R8-R12 / R14 flow state promotion
items.rationale: Acceptance-review safety depends on preventing manual completion or promotion when the artifact is missing or verdict is blocked, amend_required, or waiting for user decision.
items.evidence: spec-review.json finding 4; src/flow/lib/flow-judgment-contract.js is identified as the existing completion validation integration point.
